title: The smaller data tables, version.json and the generated server payloads
description: One $def per file: terrains, teams, phases, chapters, variants, skins, fly, strats, anim, fx, natural, unit_colours, sky, dust, constants (data/README.md documents each), version (written by validate_data.py --write-version), bt2_snapshot (gen_bt_data.py from the Worker) and bt_data (gen_bt_data.py --snapshot).

terrains.description: relief choice -> Thai name; what it does is code

teams.description: the 8 team colours in order (team index mod 8)

order.description: the five phases of a team's turn

chapters.description: Thai chapter name (the value of a knight's ch) -> colours

additionalProperties.description: model j of the squad uses kit list[j % length]

items.description: figure kit key (kits.json; a unit key or a variant/skin kit)

skins.description: unit key -> alternative looks; index 0 is the default; the index travels with the army list

k.description: figure kit key (kits.json; a unit key or a variant/skin kit)

fly.description: kit key -> flight look (cosmetic; rules use the base on the ground)

strats.description: stratagem code -> name and command-point cost

anim.description: kit key -> how the figure attacks

g.description: gun name (anim.json g; tracer and fx_gun key)

prefixItems.description: "r,g,b" string as the page wrote it
"r,g,b" string as the page wrote it
"r,g,b" string as the page wrote it

oneOf.description: "r,g,b" string as the page wrote it

fx_st.description: effect kind -> default tracer when the gun has none

fx_generic.description: gun names whose kind comes from the weapon's Thai name

mach8.description: kit keys that explode when destroyed

beast8.description: kit keys excluded from mach8 although they carry a turret

natural.description: material names that keep their own colour instead of the team tint (use the key set)

glow.description: "r,g,b" string as the page wrote it

additionalProperties.description: "r,g,b" string as the page wrote it

RULES_V.description: the page's rules version; the Worker gates on it (BT_RULES)

APP_VER.description: the page's APP_VER the export came from

GREN_R.description: grenade range in inches, centre to centre between the closest models of the two squads

HEAL_ON.description: a heal roll succeeds on HEAL_ON+ (one d6)

PAIN_ROUND.description: from this round on the dark elves (de) get +1 to hit in melee and may charge after advancing

rules_ver.description: the new app's rules version (core/version.gd RULES_V)

data_hash.description: sha256 of every data/*.json except this file, concatenated in sorted file-name order

bt_army_en.description: army code -> English name the server uses

bt2.description: the Worker's copy of every datasheet keyed by k (stats identical to types.json, weapon names in English)

fac.description: army code from facs.json, or '*' = every army

nm.description: Thai unit name; must be a key of data/i18n_en.json

inv.description: invulnerable save n++ (AP does not apply)

ld.description: leadership: nerve test passes on 2d6 >= ld

r.description: base radius in inches (default 0.8 when absent). The one non-integer field in a datasheet; core converts it once to MI (r*1000) and never uses the float

aoc.description: armour of faith: incoming AP is 1 lower

aura.description: aura within AURA_R (6"): hit +1 / pass nerve / 5++ save / reanimate on REZ_AURA+ / -1 to be hit by shooting

ca.description: +1 attack per model in melee on the turn it charged

fly.description: flies: may shoot and charge after falling back (flight height is visual, fly.json)

st.description: stealth: -1 to hit it with ranged attacks

rez.description: reanimates: fallen models stand up on rez+ in the command phase

heel.description: an unmodified 6 to wound slays him

wind.description: stands up at the next command phase; first time for sure, later on wind+

spawn.description: a squad carried inside, comes out from round 2 or when destroyed

heal.description: heals a friendly squad within heal" instead of shooting

ttn.description: titanic: shoots while engaged, acts after falling back

vsh.description: void shield layers; each swallows one failed save's damage, all return at the command phase

gk.description: glory: every model it slays in melee heals it one wound

ch.description: chapter heading (power-armour knights): a key of chapters.json

nm.description: English weapon name as the server tells Claude

a.description: attacks per model (dice in the hit roll = models x a; the lint caps one roll at 60 dice)

ap.description: armour penetration (target's save is worse by this)

dw.description: wound roll 6 = damage that ignores saves

po.description: poison: wounds infantry on po+ regardless of T

fx.description: effect kind: a key of fx.json fxs (visual + sound only)

bs.description: ballistic skill: hit on bs+; 0 or absent only with tr (auto-hit)

rf.description: rapid fire: +rf attacks per model within half range

hv.description: heavy: +1 to hit when the squad stood still

su.description: sustained: hit roll 6 = one extra hit

tr.description: torrent: hits automatically, no hit roll

bl.description: blast: +1 attack per 5 models in the target squad

mk.description: markerlight: a hit marks the target, friendly shooting at it is +1 to hit this turn
